content:
I did some experimenting and I understand the process better but I still don't know why you're experiencing what you are.

The accounts order is stored in prefs.js . Normally, when you rearrange the accounts, that file is immediately updated by Thunderbird and is saved permanently when you exit the program. My first thought was that that file was somehow marked as read-only and not updatable, but the fact that your file changes date/time when you exit tells me that it's generally writable but for some reason, your new account order changes are not.
